meaning: Incompatibility clean-up core (#576) in the shared capacity/actuality vocabulary (Being, Respect, MovedIn, InAct, CanBe): the Megarian thesis that whatever is able to be r is actually r, present motion, motion's incompleteness (what is being moved toward r is not yet actually r) and the ability of what is moved (it is able to be r) cannot all hold. Something is moved toward some r; it is able to be r, so by the thesis it is actually r; but it is not yet actually r. The certificate composes MEGARIAN-THESIS-ABOLISHES-MOTION. Each single removal has a registered model (MODEL-MEGARIAN-CAPACITY-UNACTUALIZED-ABILITY, -NOTHING-MOVED, -MOVED-ALREADY-ACTUAL, -MOVED-WITHOUT-ABILITY), so the core is inclusion-minimal. It certifies that the four positions are jointly inconsistent under this encoding, not which one is false: rejecting the Megarian thesis is one exit, denying present motion, the incompleteness of motion or the ability of what is moved are the others.
